definitions.explanation: A concrete measure or plan for fixing a problem or making something better, as in business, government and school reports.

examples.japanese: {改善策|かいぜんさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: To think of ways to improve things.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{具体的|ぐたいてき}→具体的：04781_gutaiteki⟧な{改善策|かいぜんさく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{示|しめ}された→示す：01948_shimesu⟧。
examples.english: Concrete remedial measures were presented at the meeting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べ→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧、⟦{再発|さいはつ}{防止|ぼうし}→再発防止：20419_saihatsuboushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{改善策|かいぜんさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まとめた→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧。
examples.english: We investigated the cause of the accident and drew up measures to prevent it happening again.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {改善策|かいぜんさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{講|こう}じる→講じる：27841_koujiru⟧: to take remedial measures
- {改善策|かいぜんさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}ち{出|だ}す→打ち出す：06790_uchidasu⟧ / ⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧: to put forward a plan for improvement
- ⟦{具体的|ぐたいてき}→具体的：04781_gutaiteki⟧な{改善策|かいぜんさく}: concrete measures

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{改善|かいぜん}→改善：00144_kaizen⟧ (improvement) + 〜⟦{策|さく}→策：09997_saku⟧ (measure, plan), as in ⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧ and ⟦{解決策|かいけつさく}→解決策：19395_kaiketsusaku⟧.
